1_pb_pid_exists_helper.description: New pb_pid_exists() function in §5. Returns 0=signalable/exists, 1=ESRCH/gone, 2=EPERM/exists-but-no-permission. Used by pb_trap_cleanup to correctly distinguish process states during termination polling.

2_pb_trap_cleanup_termination_order.finding: R16 called wait before the bounded poll and SIGKILL fallback; wait could block indefinitely if SIGTERM did not terminate PocketBase
2_pb_trap_cleanup_termination_order.fix: New order: (1) SIGTERM with rc noted; (2) bounded kill -0 poll 10x0.5s; (3) SIGKILL + CLEANUP_FAILURE + brief poll 6x0.5s if still alive; (4) bounded wait for reap only — placed after termination confirmed or CLEANUP_FAILURE set; (5) RELEASE1B_PB_PID=0
2_pb_trap_cleanup_termination_order.or_true_site: wait || true retained as BENIGN at step 4: reap is bounded because process state was already confirmed; wait returns nonzero for a signal-killed process

3_concurrency_auth_pre_worker_validation.finding: R16 did not validate each pre-worker setup step independently
3_concurrency_auth_pre_worker_validation.fix: Five explicit pre-worker steps with t_harness_err on failure: (1) ORDINARY_ID_FILE non-empty; (2) user record HTTP status == 200; (3) response path file exists; (4) email extraction rc and content valid; (5) WRONG_PW_FILE exists. Per-worker body generation validated with t_harness_err before launch.

4_concurrency_auth_per_worker_dirs.description: Each worker now uses a separate isolated directory under RELEASE1B_TEST_TMP. Body, status, and response-path files all live under the worker-specific dir. Directory cleaned up after result classification.

5_concurrency_otp_send_group.description: New t_concurrency_otp_send_group() in §36b. Pre-worker setup validated step-by-step (ID, record, email, OTP endpoint probe). MANDATORY-DEFERRED if Mailhog absent or OTP endpoint returns 404. If available: N=4 concurrent OTP-send requests with per-worker isolation. Accepted statuses: 200, 204, 429.

6_concurrency_idempotency_post_group.description: New t_concurrency_idempotency_post_group() in §36c. Unconditionally MANDATORY-DEFERRED: idempotency endpoint route, key header, and expected duplicate-record behavior are all NEEDS-EXTERNAL.

7_t_concurrency_group_updated.description: t_concurrency_group() now calls all three concurrency functions: t_concurrency_auth_group, t_concurrency_otp_send_group, t_concurrency_idempotency_post_group.

8_three_state_final_result.finding: R16 allowed RESULT: PASS even with mandatory-deferred or unresolved items
8_three_state_final_result.fix: Three states: FAIL (rc=1) if T_BLOCKING>0 || T_FAIL>0 || T_HARNESS_ERR>0 || CLEANUP_FAILURE>0; INCOMPLETE (rc=2) if no failures but T_DEFERRED>0 || T_UNRESOLVED>0; PASS (rc=0) only if no failures and no gaps. INCOMPLETE explicitly cannot support Checkpoint 0 authorization.

9_pb_pid_exists_selftest.description: t_harness_selftest() now includes a self-test assertion for pb_pid_exists with a non-existent PID (expected return 1).
